steps.title: Do One-Time Registration (OTR) on the National Scholarship Portal
steps.detail: Use your own mobile number.

steps.title: Find 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships' and fill the application
steps.detail: Keep your marks memo and income certificate ready to upload.

steps.title: Submit before the deadline
steps.detail: Download the submitted form for your records.

steps.title: Institute and district verification
steps.detail: Ask your school/college to verify it on the portal; this is often where applications get stuck.

steps.title: Track your status
steps.detail: Log in to NSP and check 'Application status'.

schemes.after_apply: Your institute must verify the form on NSP, then the district/state. Check status every 2 weeks. If it is 'pending at institute', remind your college office. If rejected, read the reason and apply again in the next cycle.

schemes.deadline_note: Official notice said 31 Oct 2026; reported extended to 30 Nov 2026. Confirm on NSP today.

verification.note: AICTE notice dated 19 Jun 2026 gives last date 31 Oct 2026; Buddy4Study reports extension to 30 Nov 2026.

steps.detail: Only listed quality institutions (about 1,400) qualify.

steps.title: Register and fill the common loan application
steps.detail: One form reaches several banks.

steps.title: Pick a bank and upload documents
steps.detail: Interest is capped at the bank's EBLR + 0.5%.

steps.title: Track the bank's decision on the portal
steps.detail: Banks usually reply within a few weeks.

schemes.after_apply: The bank reviews your application on the portal. Interest help is limited to 1 lakh students a year and can be used once. Only borrow what you need.
